tools.name: dodogeny_receipt_ocr_convert_image_to_base64_string
tools.description:
Dodogeny Receipt OCR performs receipt image transcription by using ==OCR and machine learning==. 
Provided with a ==photo of a receipt==, Dodogeny Receipt OCR ==recognizes and extracts== key information like total amount, tax amount, date of purchase, merchant information, and line item amounts.

==Leverage== our optimized OCR technology to parse receipts in your application in real-time.. convert an image ( *.JPEG, *.JPG, *.PNG, *.GIF ) or pdf file ( *.PDF ) to base64 string equivalent.
